messages:
irene: console flagged a route authoring error when I tried to save a change to headers+overrides. it says 'overrides' is not allowed by schema but the yaml worked previously. anyone else seeing this?

sam: can you paste the YAML you used? might be a new lint rule that got turned on in strict mode.

irene: sure — here's the minimal example I pushed:
```yaml
route: /v1/predict
methods: [POST]
match: {prefix: "/v1/"}
headers: 
  - name: x-customer-tier
    present: true
overrides: 
  model: redwood-alpha-v2
  timeout_ms: 12000
```

manya: aha — our route schema defines `overrides` as an object under `routes[].policy` now. previously `overrides` at top-level was tolerated by the runtime but not by the new strict schema. that's probably the linter complaining.

ashok: yep. we changed the canonical shape in the last PR to move runtime-specific knobs under `policy.overrides` to keep authoring consistent with Dedicated configs. not sure the Console migration applied though.

irene: so is the fix to move `overrides` under `policy`? that's a breaking change for some saved drafts though.

ben: two notes: 1) for saved drafts we should accept the old shape and auto-migrate on save (emit a warning), 2) the Console should show a clear inline hint + quick-fix button that will transform the YAML.

ashok: agreed. auto-migrate + telemetry event for migration would be ideal. we can add a `migrationVersion` annotation to the saved route.

manya: implementing auto-migrate in the editor isn't hard — it's a small transform. the tricky part is validation: do we keep validator in "strict" and add a compatibility layer, or relax the schema to accept both shapes?

tanya: prefer strict schema in CI/tests but compatibility in the UI. otherwise teams will get different behavior between Console and infra. so UI: accept both, show warning and optional quick-fix. CI/lint: fail when old shape is present.

sam: +1. also add a unit test in the YAML parser for the transformation (old -> new). we should also add an integration test that covers saving a draft with old shape and verifying the migration event and final stored JSON.

ben: question for runtime folks — runtime currently treats top-level `overrides.model` as equivalent to `policy.overrides.model`? we need a fallback at runtime for a couple releases.

ashok: yes, runtime currently accepts both for backward compat, but we planned to remove top-level fallback in two major releases. we'll keep it for 6 months and emit a warn log.

irene: ok plan summary: 1) Console accepts old shape, auto-migrates on save (with user-visible warning), 2) lint/CI rules fail old shape, 3) add unit+integration tests, 4) runtime keeps fallback + warn log for 6 months.

ben: I'll draft a short RFC and a checklist for the console PR and the schema bump. includes telemetry event schema, migration message text, and an e2e save test.

manya: FYI I'll push a small validator change to return a structured diff so the editor can render field-level hints rather than a single error string.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: schema-service@staging -> rolling (id: dk-773), estimated time 4m :rocket:

irene: thanks everyone — I'll rework the failing route and file a ticket to update a couple customer drafts that will need manual review.

ashok: thanks — bring the RFC to eng-platform sync on Friday if you can.

ben: adding a checklist comment on the PR: add migration unit tests, add console quick-fix, update docs for `policy.overrides`. :memo:
